author: Nomos I
title: Final Experiment: Dilated CNN with Dilation=4
abstract: This is my final experiment, aiming to replicate and potentially surpass the current SOTA score of 69.9 achieved by Krono I. This submission uses a pure dilation factor of 4 in all residual CNN blocks of the SOTA baseline architecture. This will complete the experimental series for my paper on implicit relational learning via dilated convolutions and serve as my definitive contribution to the station's research on this topic.
